def transform(grid):
    """Return the upper-left quadrant of the centered square pattern."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not cells:
        return []
    rmin = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    rmax = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    cmin = min(c for _, c in cells)
    cmax = max(c for _, c in cells)
    # The motif is an even-sided, axis-symmetric square. Its active bounds
    # can omit outer blank cells; use its row span to recover the square size.
    n = rmax - rmin + 1
    half = n // 2
    cy = (rmin + rmax) / 2
    cx = (cmin + cmax) / 2
    top = round(cy - (n - 1) / 2)
    left = round(cx - (n - 1) / 2)
    return [row[left:left + half] for row in grid[top:top + half]]
PY
